query_languages.note: ASL default; JSONPath reference syntax with $-anchored paths.

query_languages.name: JSONata
query_languages.note: Opt-in per machine or per state via QueryLanguage. JSONata-only keys (Arguments/Output/Assign) are invalid under JSONPath.

integration_patterns.note: Task returns after the API call; the job keeps running in the background.
Step Functions waits for job completion - replaces hand-rolled Wait+poll loops. Supported for Athena startQueryExecution, Glue, EMR, ECS runTask, Batch, SageMaker, and more.
Pauses until an external process returns the task token (e.g. a worker in a queue).

distributed_map.note: DISTRIBUTED mode fans out via child workflow executions; concurrency must respect downstream service quotas (Lambda reserved concurrency, API limits).
